headline: Houthi Missile Strike Hits Riyadh Airport, Injuring Dozens and Halting Flights
subheadline: Houthi missile strike shut down Riyadh's King Khalid Airport as Israeli forces killed a Jenin Brigades commander and Hamas attacker.
lede: Houthi forces launched a missile strike on Riyadh's King Khalid International Airport, injuring multiple people and temporarily shutting down air traffic. Israeli forces and Shin Bet eliminated a Jenin Brigades commander and a Hamas attacker involved in the October 7 massacre. Lebanese security forces seized a truck carrying 800kg of explosives bound for Hezbollah operatives in Dahieh. Israeli defense spokesperson confirmed a successful interception of a suspected aerial target over southern Lebanon.

sections.title: Russian Advances Amid Drone Barrage Across Ukraine
sections.body: Russian forces reportedly took control of villages Lukashovo and Lobanovka in the Kharkov region. Multiple Geran'-5 and reconnaissance drones were launched from Russian territory and occupied areas, attacking Kyiv, Chernihiv and other regions. A Russian Shahed drone struck a nine-story residential building in Dnipro, injuring three people. Ukrainian Air Force reportedly lost aircraft due to malfunction of old Soviet missiles used against drones.

sections.title: Intelligence Assessment
sections.body: The data shows expanding regional escalation in the Middle East with direct attacks on critical infrastructure and continued weapons smuggling, while Iranian-backed groups retain operational capability despite Israeli strikes. In Ukraine, sustained drone and missile barrages coincide with Russian territorial gains in Kharkov and Ukrainian difficulties due to aging Soviet missile systems malfunctioning during interceptions. The convergence of multiple front activities raises the risk of inadvertent escalation into a wider regional war.
